name: 发送时选区快照的分页读口（read_selection）
subject: agent.context-selection-read

forbidden_derivations.why: The live canvas selection can change after the message is sent and is not the immutable snapshot attached to that message.
The timeline read returns the project timeline, not which clips were selected when this message was sent.

notes: The tool is internal-only because only the desktop Agent lane carries a message-scoped contextSnapshot. The cursor is opaque to the model, bound to the current snapshot object and kind filter, and never persisted across messages.
